messages:
maria: Heads-up — eu-west3 is spiking on local NVMe writes, GPU attach failures increasing. I see a deep-compact run from grit-cleaner hitting cohort-42.

alex: yup saw that at ~14:02 UTC. write_iops jumped ~6x on the hotstripes; provisioner queue length +40. link: https://grafana.redwood/eu-west3/pm 

jamal: logs show repeated `blk_update_request: I/O error` on /dev/nvme1n1 around the same time, but devices remain online. latency climbing to ~55ms for small writes.

infra-bot: alert: NVME_WRITE_SURGE eu-west3 cohort-42 — threshold breached (4m). escalation: eng-infra.

katie: grit-cleaner did a compact+rewrite for tombstones — it's multi-threaded by default. can we throttle concurrency for that job? set to 2? :thinking_face:

alex: we should throttle asap and avoid full cohort compaction until we stabilize. Also reduce batch size for GPU attach in that AZ to avoid hotstripe amplification.

maria: oncall @sre-jen can you pause grit-cleaner for cohort-42 and soft-retire the hottest devices from the provisioner for 20m?

sre-jen: taking it. running command now: `kubectl -n infra exec grit-cleaner-ctrl -- gritctl pause --cohort=42`

jamal: also recommend setting `compact_parallelism=1` and `write_backoff_ms=50` as a temporary knob. that'll slow throughput but reduce write amplification.

alex: I'm rolling a canary config to infra-config: `grit_cleaner.compact_parallelism=1` for eu-west3 pool. Patch applied to 2 nodes (canary).

infra-bot: deploybot: config-rollout started for infra-config in eu-west3 (canary=2 nodes).

maria: metrics: write_iops down ~70% on the canary nodes after 3 minutes, provisioner queue length dropping. good sign.

sre-jen: paused grit-cleaner for cohort-42. soft-retired 3 devices from pool-eu-west3-hot. redirecting new GPU requests to eu-west1 temporarily.

katie: long-term: need smarter compaction scheduling (stagger by device temp and iops), and a guard that prevents compaction if attach latency > X. filed ticket INFRA-2147.

alex: agree. short term action items in thread: 1) keep compact_parallelism=1 for 30m 2) keep cohort-42 paused for 20m 3) route new gpu attaches away from affected hotstripe 4) monitor device SMART + attach success rate.

maria: thanks all. I'll keep the thread updated. if metrics stay stable after 20m we'll unpause and gradually ramp compaction.

jamal: FYI I collected kernel traces and nvme SMART snapshots, uploading to /shared/ops/eu-west3/grit-1769998765.tar.gz 

maria: update @channel — 25m after throttle: write_iops baseline restored, attach error rate back to normal. unpausing grit-cleaner with compact_parallelism=1 and a 5m ramp.

sre-jen: unpause done. keeping cohort-42 on soft-retire until next maintenance window if we see any regressions.

katie: created follow-up doc in Confluence: 'grit-cleaner compaction safety knobs' and linked INFRA-2147.

maria: resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
